description: Price history for one fertilizer product across report periods, from the same twice-monthly USDA MARS production cost reports behind get_fertilizer_price. Use for input-cost trends; use get_fertilizer_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns up to `periods` most recent reports, oldest first (default 12, max 52 — roughly two years of twice-monthly reports).

periods.description: Number of most recent report periods to return (default 12, max 52)

name: get_fertilizer_history
